Dear Vendor:

Your company now has the option of receiving payments from Lincolnway Energy electronically. Payments can be direct
deposited via an Automated Clearing House (ACH).

If you would like to receive your vendor payment electronically in the future, please complete and return the
authorization form below. You can mail the completed form to Lincolnway Energy, 59511 W Lincoln Hwy, Nevada, IA
50201 or email the form to accounting at lwecorn@lincolnwayenergy.com. If you have any questions about receiving
your payment electronically, please contact accounting at the above email or call (515) 232-1010.

                                                Authorization Statement

On behalf of the institution named below, I authorization Lincolnway Energy, LLC to send my vendor check to the
financial institution named below to be deposited in the designated account. In the event funds are deposited
erroneously into my account, I authorize Lincolnway Energy to debit my account not to exceed the original amount of
the credit.

I understand that all direct deposits are made through the automated clearing house (ACH), and the funds availability is
subject to terms and limitations of the ACH as well as my financial Institution. I also understand that it is my
responsibility to keep this account information current with Lincolnway Energy. This authority remains in effect until
Lincolnway Energy receives written notice to cancel it.
